papers.title_en: Market Power and Capital Constraints
papers.title_zh: 市场势力与资本约束
papers.abstract_en: We explore how traders’ equity capitalization influences asset prices in a framework that accounts for market power. In our model, traders with capital constraints engage in transactions in an imperfectly competitive market. We demonstrate that looser capital constraints elevate both asset prices and price impact, the latter diminishing market liquidity. Using Canadian Treasury auction data, we illustrate how to apply our model to quantify these effects. We estimate the shadow costs of capital constraints by leveraging a temporary policy exemption during 2020–2021. We show that while these constraints are only infrequently binding, their relative impact when activated can be sizable. (JEL E63, G12, G14, G23, G41, L13)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在考虑市场力量的框架下，交易者的股本资本化如何影响资产价格。在我们的模型中，有资本约束的交易者在不完全竞争的市场中进行交易。我们证明，较宽松的资本约束会提高资产价格和价格影响，后者降低了市场流动性。利用加拿大国库拍卖数据，我们展示了如何应用我们的模型来量化这些效应。我们通过利用2020-2021年期间的临时政策豁免来估计资本约束的影子成本。我们表明，尽管这些约束很少被激活，但当激活时它们的相对影响可能是巨大的。（JEL E63, G12, G14, G23, G41, L13）

papers.title_en: A Long and a Short Leg Make for a Wobbly Equilibrium
papers.title_zh: 长短腿导致不稳定的平衡
papers.abstract_en: We provide a model to explain how the interaction between the spot and lending markets for stocks can lead to abrupt changes in short selling activity. Furthermore, rational short sellers may choose to abandon the market even as mispricing widens. We document empirically that the dynamics of short selling are fat tailed and subject to abrupt changes, especially for the stocks that the model identifies as susceptible to such dynamics. (JEL G11, G12, G14, G41)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提供了一个模型来解释股票现货市场和借贷市场之间的互动如何导致做空活动突然变化。此外，理性的做空者甚至可能选择退出市场，尽管定价错误扩大。我们从实证上记录了做空动态是厚尾的，并且容易突然变化，特别是对于模型识别为容易受到这种动态影响的股票。（JEL G11, G12, G14, G41）

papers.title_en: Spillovers in State Capacity Building: Evidence from the Digitization of Land Records in Pakistan
papers.title_zh: 国家能力建设中的溢出效应：来自巴基斯坦土地记录数字化的证据
papers.abstract_en: Digitization reforms have been hailed as an effective way of strengthening state capacity. However, digitization can also fundamentally reshape the organization of bureaucracies. Using a unique administrative dataset on agricultural taxation and surveys of local bureaucrats from Punjab, Pakistan, we show that digitization reforms can have unintended consequences for state capacity. We exploit the staggered rollout of the digitization of land records in Punjab to show that digitization had a negative effect on tax collection. The fall in taxes was not due to a decrease in the tax base. Instead, digitization affected the bureaucrats’ capacity to collect taxes. (JEL D73, H11, H71, O12, O17)
papers.abstract_zh: 数字化改革被誉为加强国家能力的有效途径。然而，数字化也可能从根本上重塑官僚机构的组织结构。利用巴基斯坦旁遮普省农业税收的独特行政数据集和对当地官僚的调查，我们展示了数字化改革可能对国家能力产生意外后果。我们利用旁遮普省土地记录数字化的分阶段推出，表明数字化对税收征收产生了负面影响。税收下降并非由于税基减少。相反，数字化影响了官僚征税的能力。（JEL D73, H11, H71, O12, O17）

papers.title_en: Similarity of Information and Collective Action
papers.title_zh: 信息的相似性与集体行动
papers.abstract_en: We study a canonical collective action game with incomplete information. Individuals attempt to coordinate to achieve a shared goal, while also facing a temptation to free-ride. More similar information can help them coordinate, but it can also exacerbate free-riding. Our main result shows that more similar information facilitates (impedes) achieving the common goal when it is sufficiently challenging (easy). We apply this insight to show why less powerful authoritarian governments may face larger protests if they restrict press freedom, when committee diversity is beneficial in costly voting, and when a more diverse community contributes more to public good provision. (JEL C71, D71, D72, D81, D82, D83, H41)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个具有不完全信息的经典集体行动博弈。个体试图协调以实现共同目标，同时也面临着搭便车的诱惑。更相似的信息可以帮助他们协调，但也可能加剧搭便车行为。我们的主要结果表明，当共同目标足够具有挑战性（容易）时，更相似的信息有助于（阻碍）实现共同目标。我们将这一见解应用于解释为什么权力较小的威权政府如果限制新闻自由可能会面临更大的抗议，当委员会多样性在成本投票中有益时，以及当更多样化的社区对公共产品供给贡献更多时。（JEL C71, D71, D72, D81, D82, D83, H41）

papers.title_en: Abundance from Abroad: Migrant Income and Long-Run Economic Development
papers.title_zh: 海外丰盈：移民收入与长期经济发展
papers.abstract_en: We study how international migrant income prospects affect long-run development in origin areas. We leverage the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis exchange rate shocks in a shift-share identification strategy across Philippine provinces. Initial migrant income shocks are magnified six-fold over time, increasing domestic income, education levels, migrant skills, and high-skilled migration. Remarkably, 74.9 percent of long-run income gains come from domestic rather than migrant income. Trade driven impacts of exchange rate shocks are orthogonal to effects via migrant income. A structural model reveals that 19.7 percent of long-run income gains stem from educational investments. International migration fosters broad economic development in origin communities. (JEL F22, F31, G01, J24, J82, O15, O16)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究国际移民的收入前景如何影响原籍地区的长期发展。我们利用1997年亚洲金融危机汇率冲击，在菲律宾各省份采用份额变化识别策略。初始移民收入冲击随时间放大六倍，提高了国内收入、教育水平、移民技能和高技能移民。值得注意的是，74.9%的长期收入增长来自国内而非移民收入。汇率冲击通过贸易驱动的影响与通过移民收入的影响是正交的。一个结构模型揭示，19.7%的长期收入增长来自教育投资。国际移民促进了原籍社区的广泛经济发展。（JEL F22, F31, G01, J24, J82, O15, O16）

papers.title_en: Games on Multiplex Networks
papers.title_zh: 多路复用网络上的游戏
papers.abstract_en: We develop a simple multilayer network model in which agents allocate effort across layers with heterogeneous structures, subject to an aggregate effort constraint. Incentives are shaped by agents’ network positions within each layer, and equilibrium behavior reflects both within- and cross-layer interactions. We analyze how shocks propagate through the network and characterize optimal targeting interventions. Our results show that effective policy design must account for effort allocation across layers. We also demonstrate that predictions from monolayer models can diverge sharply from those of multilayer models, underscoring the importance of accounting for network complexity in both empirical and policy analyses. (JEL C70, D78, D82, D85, H41, Z13)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简单的多层网络模型，其中个体在具有异质结构的层之间分配努力，受到总体努力约束的限制。激励机制由个体在每一层网络中的位置塑造，均衡行为反映了层内和跨层的互动。我们分析了冲击如何在网络中传播，并描述了最优的定向干预措施。我们的结果显示，有效的政策设计必须考虑跨层的努力分配。我们还证明了单层模型的预测可能与多层模型的预测大相径庭，强调了在实证和政策分析中考虑网络复杂性的重要性。（JEL C70, D78, D82, D85, H41, Z13）

papers.title_en: Marginal Returns to Public Universities
papers.title_zh: 公共大学的边际回报
papers.abstract_en: Abstract This article studies the returns to enrolling in U.S. public universities by comparing the long-term outcomes of barely admitted versus barely rejected applicants. I use administrative admission records spanning all 35 public universities in Texas, which collectively enroll 10% of all American public university students, to systematically identify and employ decentralized cutoffs in SAT/ACT scores that generate discontinuities in admission and enrollment. The typical marginally admitted student gains an additional year of education in the four-year sector, becomes 12 percentage points more likely to ever earn a bachelor’s degree, and eventually earns 8% more than their marginally rejected but otherwise identical counterpart. Marginally admitted students pay no additional tuition costs thanks to offsetting grant aid; cost-benefit calculations show internal rates of return of 26% for the marginal students themselves, 16% for society (which must pay for the additional education), and 7% for the government budget. Earnings gains are similar across admitting institutions of varying selectivity, but smaller for students from low-income families, who spend more time enrolled but complete fewer degrees and major in less lucrative fields. Finally, I develop a method to separately identify effects for students on the extensive margin of attending any university versus those on the margin of attending a more selective one, revealing larger effects on the extensive margin.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文通过比较勉强被录取与勉强被拒绝的申请者长期结果，研究了就读美国公立大学的回报。我使用了涵盖德克萨斯州所有35所公立大学的行政录取记录，这些大学共同招收了10%的美国公立大学生，系统地识别并利用分散的SAT/ACT分数截止点，在录取和入学中产生不连续性。典型的勉强被录取学生在四年制部门额外获得一年的教育，获得学士学位的可能性比勉强被拒绝但其他方面相同的学生高出12个百分点，最终收入高出8%。勉强被录取的学生由于抵消性助学金而无需支付额外学费；成本效益计算显示，边际学生的内部回报率为26%，社会（必须支付额外教育费用）为16%，政府预算为7%。不同选择性的录取机构的收益增长相似，但来自低收入家庭的学生收益较小，他们注册时间更长，完成学位更少，主修领域盈利性较低。最后，我开发了一种方法，分别识别在广泛边际上参加任何大学的学生与在边际上参加更具选择性的大学的学生的效果，揭示了在广泛边际上更大的影响。

papers.title_en: Enlightenment Ideals and Belief in Progress in the Run-up to the Industrial Revolution: A Textual Analysis
papers.title_zh: 工业革命前夕的启蒙理想与进步信仰：文本分析
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We trace the evolution of the language of science, religion, and political economy in the centuries leading to the British Industrial Revolution. Using textual analysis of 264,443 works printed in England between 1500 and 1900, we test whether British culture manifested a belief in progress associated with science and industry. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, there was a separation in the languages of science and religion beginning in the mid-eighteenth century. Second, volumes using language at the nexus of science and political economy became more progress-oriented during the Enlightenment. Third, volumes using industrial language—especially those at the science-political economy nexus—were more progress-oriented beginning in the eighteenth century.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们追溯了英国工业革命前几个世纪科学、宗教和政治经济学语言的演变。通过分析1500年至1900年间在英格兰印刷的264,443部作品的文本，我们测试了英国文化是否表现出与科学和工业相关的进步信念。我们的分析得出三个主要发现。首先，从18世纪中叶开始，科学和宗教的语言出现了分离。其次，在启蒙时期，使用科学和政治经济学交汇处语言的卷册变得更加以进步为导向。第三，从18世纪开始，使用工业语言的卷册——特别是那些在科学和政治经济学交汇处的卷册——变得更加以进步为导向。

papers.title_en: Republican Support and Economic Hardship: The Enduring Effects of the Opioid Epidemic
papers.title_zh: 共和党支持与经济困难：阿片类药物流行病的持久影响
papers.abstract_en: Abstract In this article, we establish a causal connection between two of the most salient social developments in the United States over the past decades: the opioid epidemic and the political realignment between the Republican and Democratic parties. Drawing on unsealed records from litigation against Purdue Pharma, we uncover rich geographic variation in the marketing of prescription opioids that serves as a quasi-exogenous source of exposure to the epidemic. We use this variation to document significant increases in drug-related mortality and greater reliance on public transfer programs. This induced economic hardship led to substantial changes in the political landscape of the communities most affected by the opioid epidemic. We estimate that from the mid-2000s to 2022, exposure to the opioid epidemic continuously increased the Republican vote share in House, presidential, and gubernatorial elections. By the 2022 House elections, a one-standard-deviation increase in our measure of exposure led to a 4.5 percentage point increase in the Republican vote share. From 2012 until 2022, this increase in the House vote share translated into Republicans winning additional seats.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在本文中，我们建立了美国过去几十年中两个最显著社会发展之间的因果关系：阿片类药物流行和共和党与民主党之间的政治重新结盟。我们利用针对普渡制药公司的诉讼中未封存的记录，揭示了处方阿片类药物营销中丰富的地理变化，这作为流行病暴露的准外生来源。我们利用这种变化来记录与药物相关的死亡率显著增加和对公共转移计划的更大依赖。这种诱导的经济困难导致了受阿片类药物流行影响最大的社区政治格局的实质性变化。我们估计，从2000年代中期到2022年，阿片类药物流行暴露持续增加了众议院、总统和州长选举中共和党的投票份额。到2022年众议院选举时，我们衡量暴露的一标准差增加导致了共和党投票份额增加了4.5个百分点。从2012年到2022年，众议院投票份额的这种增加转化为共和党赢得了额外的席位。

papers.title_en: Bargaining and Inequality in the Labor Market
papers.title_zh: 劳动力市场中的讨价还价与不平等
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We use novel surveys of firms and workers, linked to administrative employer-employee data, to study the prevalence and importance of individual bargaining in wage determination. We show that simple survey questions accurately elicit firms’ bargaining strategies. Using the elicited strategies for 772 German firms, we document that the majority of firms are willing to engage in individual wage bargaining. Labor market factors predict firms’ strategies better than firm characteristics. Survey responses from nearly 10,000 full-time workers indicate that most workers provide their salary expectations before they receive a job offer. Most outside offers are rejected, with the worker remaining at the incumbent firm. There is substantial heterogeneity in workers’ bargaining behavior, which translates into within-firm wage inequality. Firms that set pay via individual bargaining have a 3 percentage point higher gender wage gap.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用与行政雇主-雇员数据关联的企业和工人的新调查，研究个体谈判在工资决定中的普遍性和重要性。我们展示了简单的调查问题能够准确引出企业的谈判策略。利用772家德国企业的引出策略，我们记录了大多数企业愿意进行个体工资谈判。劳动力市场因素比企业特征更能预测企业的策略。来自近10,000名全职工人的调查回应表明，大多数工人在收到工作邀请之前会提供他们的薪资期望。大多数外部报价被拒绝，工人留在现任公司。工人的谈判行为存在显著的异质性，这转化为企业内部的工资不平等。通过个体谈判设定薪酬的企业，性别工资差距高出3个百分点。

papers.title_en: Digital Distractions with Peer Influence: The Impact of Mobile App Usage on Academic and Labor Market Outcomes
papers.title_zh: 数字干扰与同伴影响：移动应用使用对学术和劳动市场结果的影响
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Concerns about excessive mobile phone use among youth are mounting. We present estimates of behavioral and contextual peer effects, along with comprehensive evidence on how students’ own and their peers’ app usage affect academic performance, physical health, and labor market outcomes. Our analysis draws on administrative data from a Chinese university covering three student cohorts over four years. We exploit random roommate assignments, differential exposure to a policy shock (gaming restrictions for minors), and differential exposure to a discrete event (the introduction of a blockbuster video game) for identification. App usage is contagious: a one s.d. increase in roommates’ in-college app usage raises own usage by 5.8%. High app usage is harmful across all measured outcomes. A one s.d. increase in app usage reduces GPAs by 36.2% of a within-cohort-major s.d. and lowers wages by 2.3%. Roommates’ app usage reduces a student’s GPA and wages through both disruptions and behavioral spillovers, generating a total negative effect that exceeds half the magnitude of the impact from the student’s own app usage. Extending China’s three-hour-per-week gaming restriction for minors to college students would boost their initial wages by 0.9%. High-frequency GPS and app usage data show that heavy app users spend less time in study halls, are more frequently late or absent from class, and get less sleep.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：对青少年过度使用手机的担忧日益增加。我们提供了行为和情境同伴效应的估计，以及全面证据，说明学生自己和同伴的手机应用使用如何影响学业表现、身体健康和劳动市场结果。我们的分析基于中国一所大学覆盖三个学生队列四年的行政数据。我们利用随机室友分配、对政策冲击（未成年人游戏限制）的不同暴露以及对一个离散事件（一款热门视频游戏的推出）的不同暴露进行识别。应用使用具有传染性：室友在大学期间应用使用的一标准差增加，会使自己的使用增加5.8%。高应用使用对所有测量结果都是有害的。应用使用的一标准差增加会将GPA降低36.2%，将工资降低2.3%。室友的应用使用通过干扰和行为溢出效应降低学生的GPA和工资，产生的总负面影响超过学生自己应用使用影响的一半。将中国对未成年人每周三小时的游戏限制扩展到大学生，将使他们的初始工资提高0.9%。高频GPS和应用使用数据显示，重度应用用户在自习室花费的时间较少，上课迟到或缺席的频率更高，睡眠时间也更少。

papers.title_en: Vanguard: Black Veterans and Civil Rights After World War I
papers.title_zh: 先锋：第一次世界大战后黑人退伍军人与民权
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Nearly 400,000 Black men were drafted into the National Army during World War I, where they toiled primarily as menial laborers in segregated units. Leveraging novel variation from the World War I draft lottery and millions of digitized military and NAACP records, we document the pioneering role these men played in the early civil rights movement. Relative to observably similar individuals from the same draft board, Black men randomly inducted into the Army were significantly more likely to join the nascent NAACP and become prominent community leaders in the New Negro era. We find little evidence that these effects are explained by migration or improved socioeconomic status. Rather, corroborating historical accounts about the catalyzing influence of institutional racism in the military, we show that increased civic activism was driven by soldiers who experienced the most discriminatory treatment while serving their country.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：在第一次世界大战期间，近40万黑人男性被征召进入国家军队，他们主要在隔离的部队中从事苦力劳动。利用第一次世界大战征兵抽签的新变化以及数百万数字化的军事和NAACP记录，我们记录了这些男性在早期民权运动中的先锋作用。与来自同一征兵委员会的可观察相似个体相比，随机被征召入伍的黑人男性更有可能加入新兴的NAACP，并在新黑人时代成为杰出的社区领袖。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明这些效应可以通过迁移或改善的社会经济地位来解释。相反，我们证实了历史记载中关于军队制度性种族主义的催化影响，表明增加的公民活动是由在服役期间经历最严重歧视待遇的士兵推动的。

papers.title_en: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
papers.title_zh: 美元主导与货币政策传导
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否使货币政策失效？一种新兴观点认为，如果一个国家用美元开具出口发票，汇率就无法稳定经济活动，因为传统的支出转换渠道被削弱了。这种观点基于出口价格在美元中具有粘性的前提，打破了出口需求与贬值之间的联系。但这一假设并未得到数据支持：以美元定价的商品往往价格更具灵活性，并且具有更高的替代弹性。我们提出了一个基于更现实假设的模型，并表明即使采用美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值，仍然可以显著提升出口和活动。任何扩张的极限不是需求，而是供应能力。我们还表明，低汇率传递到美元价格并不反映价格粘性。即使价格灵活，当需求弹性高时，价格对汇率的反应也很小：低传递是均衡结果，不是名义摩擦的证据。

papers.title_en: Failing Banks
papers.title_zh: 破产银行
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Why do banks fail? We create a panel covering most commercial banks from 1863 through 2024 to study the history of failing banks in the United States. Failing banks are characterized by rising asset losses, deteriorating solvency, and an increasing reliance on expensive noncore funding. These commonalities imply that bank failures are highly predictable using simple accounting metrics from publicly available financial statements. Failures with runs were common before deposit insurance, but these failures are strongly related to weak fundamentals, casting doubt on the importance of non-fundamental runs. Furthermore, low recovery rates on failed banks’ assets suggest that most failed banks subject to runs were fundamentally insolvent, barring large value destruction of receiverships. Altogether, our evidence suggests that the primary cause of bank failures and banking crises is almost always and everywhere a deterioration of bank fundamentals.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 银行为何会失败？我们创建了一个涵盖从1863年到2024年大多数商业银行的面板数据，以研究美国银行失败的历史。失败的银行以资产损失上升、偿债能力恶化和对昂贵非核心资金依赖增加为特征。这些共同点意味着，使用公开财务报表中的简单会计指标可以高度预测银行的失败。在存款保险之前，挤兑导致的失败很常见，但这些失败与基本面薄弱密切相关，这让人对非基本面挤兑的重要性产生怀疑。此外，失败银行资产的低回收率表明，大多数遭受挤兑的失败银行在根本上是资不抵债的，排除了接管过程中大规模价值破坏的可能性。总的来说，我们的证据表明，银行失败和银行危机的主要原因几乎总是、无处不在于银行基本面的恶化。

papers.title_en: Political Foundations of Racial Violence in the Post-Reconstruction South
papers.title_zh: 重建后南方种族暴力的政治基础
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Election results act as powerful signals, shaping social behavior in ways that can be dramatic and even violent. This article shows how racial violence in the post-Reconstruction U.S. South was tied to the local performance of the anti-Black Democratic Party in presidential elections. Using a regression discontinuity design based on close presidential vote shares, we find that Southern counties where Democrats lost the popular vote between 1880 and 1900 were nearly twice as likely to experience Black lynchings in the following four years. Despite no corresponding changes in local office holding, these defeats were salient among local elites. We show that Southern newspapers, closely aligned with the Democratic Party, amplified narratives of Black criminality in the aftermath of Democratic losses. Such accusations were, in turn, frequently invoked by lynch mobs. These findings point to the strategic use of racial violence by Democratic elites, foreshadowing the institutionalized vote suppression of Jim Crow.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：选举结果作为一种强有力的信号，能够以戏剧性甚至暴力的方式塑造社会行为。本文展示了美国重建后南部地区针对黑人的种族暴力与反黑民主党在总统选举中的地方表现之间的联系。基于接近的总统选票份额的回归不连续设计，我们发现在1880年至1900年间民主党在普选中失利的南方郡县，在接下来的四年中经历黑人私刑的可能性几乎是其他郡县的两倍。尽管地方官员的职位没有相应的变化，但这些失败在当地精英中是显著的。我们展示了与民主党紧密对齐的南方报纸，在民主党失利后放大了黑人犯罪的叙述。这些指控反过来经常被私刑暴徒引用。这些发现指出了民主党精英对种族暴力的战略性使用，预示着吉姆·克劳制度化投票压制的先兆。

papers.title_en: Ideas Have Consequences: The Impact of Law and Economics on American Justice
papers.title_zh: 思想有后果：法律与经济学对美国司法的影响
papers.abstract_en: Abstract This article empirically studies the effects of the early law and economics movement on the U.S. judiciary. We focus on the Manne Economics Institute for Federal Judges, an intensive economics course that trained almost half of federal judges between 1976 and 1999. Using the universe of published opinions in U.S. Circuit Courts and 1 million District Court criminal sentencing decisions, we estimate the within-judge effect of Manne program attendance. Selection into attendance was limited, as the program was popular among judges of all backgrounds, frequently oversubscribed, and admitted participants on a first-come, first-served basis. We find that after attending economics training, participating judges use more economics language in their opinions, rule against regulatory agencies more often, and impose more severe criminal sentences. We argue that economics, as a rigorous social science, was especially effective in persuading judges.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文实证研究了早期法与经济学运动对美国司法系统的影响。我们关注联邦法官曼恩经济研究所，这是一个密集型经济学课程，1976年至1999年间几乎培训了一半的联邦法官。利用美国巡回法院发表的意见全集和100万个地区法院刑事判决决定，我们估计了参加曼恩项目对法官的影响。由于该项目在所有背景的法官中广受欢迎，经常超额报名，并按先到先得的原则录取参与者，因此参加选择是有限的。我们发现，在参加经济学培训后，参与的法官在意见中更多地使用经济学语言，更频繁地对监管机构作出不利裁决，并施加更严厉的刑事判决。我们认为，经济学作为一种严谨的社会科学，在说服法官方面特别有效。

papers.title_en: How Cultural Diversity Drives Innovation: Surnames and Patents in US History
papers.title_zh: 文化多样性如何推动创新：美国历史上的姓氏与专利
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of cultural diversity on innovation. Focusing on the United States from 1850 to 1940, we develop a novel surname-based measure of cultural diversity and combine this with patent data. Leveraging quasi-random variation in counties' surname compositions driven by historical immigration, we find that rising diversity increased both the quantity and quality of innovation within counties and for individual inventors. Examining mechanisms, we provide evidence suggesting that greater surname diversity accelerated innovation both by expanding the range of ideas, skills and perspectives available for recombination and by fostering the diverse social interactions that facilitate idea sharing.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了文化多样性对创新的影响。以1850年至1940年的美国为研究对象，我们开发了一种基于姓氏的文化多样性新度量方法，并将其与专利数据相结合。利用历史移民导致的县姓氏构成中的准随机变化，我们发现多样性的增加既提高了县内的创新数量，也提高了个体发明家的创新质量。在考察机制时，我们提供的证据表明，更大的姓氏多样性通过扩大可用于重组的想法、技能和视角的范围，以及促进想法共享的多样化社会互动，加速了创新。

papers.title_en: Efficiency and Redistribution in Environmental Policy: An Equilibrium Analysis of Agricultural Supply Chains
papers.title_zh: 环境政策中的效率与再分配：农业供应链均衡分析

papers.title_en: Monotonicity and Robust Implementation Under Forward‐Induction Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 单调性与前向归纳推理下的鲁棒实施
papers.abstract_en: In sequential games, the set of paths consistent with rationality and forward‐induction reasoning may change nonmonotonically when adding transparent restrictions on players' beliefs. Yet, we prove that—in an incomplete‐information environment—predictions become sharper when the restrictions only concern initial beliefs about types. Thus, strong rationalizability for games with payoff uncertainty characterizes the path predictions of forward‐induction reasoning across all possible restrictions on players' hierarchies of exogenous beliefs. With this, we can solve an open problem: the implementation of social choice functions through sequential mechanisms under forward‐induction reasoning—which considerably expands the realm of implementable functions compared with simultaneous mechanisms (Müller (2016))—is indeed robust in the sense of Bergemann and Morris (2009).
papers.abstract_zh: 在序贯博弈中，当对玩家信念的透明限制增加时，与理性和前向归纳推理一致的路径集合可能会非单调变化。然而，我们证明了——在不完全信息环境中——当限制只涉及对类型的初始信念时，预测变得更加精确。因此，在具有收益不确定性的博弈中，强合理性表征了前向归纳推理的路径预测，跨越了对玩家外生信念层次结构的所有可能限制。通过这一点，我们可以解决一个开放问题：通过序贯机制在前向归纳推理下实施社会选择函数——与同时机制（Müller 2016）相比，这显著扩展了可实施函数的范围——确实是Bergemann和Morris（2009）意义上的稳健的。

papers.title_en: Empirical Bayes When Estimation Precision Predicts Parameters
papers.title_zh: 经验贝叶斯：当估计精度预测参数时
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian empirical Bayes methods usually maintain a precision independence assumption: The unknown parameters of interest are independent from the known standard errors of the estimates. This assumption is often theoretically questionable and empirically rejected. This paper proposes to model the conditional distribution of the parameter given the standard errors as a flexibly parameterized location‐scale family of distributions, leading to a family of methods that we call close . The close framework unifies and generalizes several proposals under precision dependence. We argue that the most flexible member of the close family is a minimalist and computationally efficient default for accounting for precision dependence. We analyze this method and show that it is competitive in terms of the regret of subsequent decision rules. Empirically, using close leads to sizable gains for selecting high‐mobility Census tracts.
papers.abstract_zh: 高斯经验贝叶斯方法通常保持一个精度独立假设：感兴趣的未知参数与估计值的已知标准误差是独立的。这个假设在理论上常常是值得怀疑的，在实证上也被拒绝。本文提出将参数的条件分布建模为给定标准误差的灵活参数化的定位-尺度分布族，从而得到我们称之为“紧密”的方法族。紧密框架统一并概括了精度依赖下的几种提议。我们认为，紧密家族中最灵活的成员是一个最小化且计算效率高的默认方法，用于考虑精度依赖。我们分析了这种方法，并表明它在后续决策规则的遗憾方面具有竞争力。从实证上看，使用紧密方法可以显著提高选择高流动性人口普查地区的收益。

papers.title_en: Dynamic Incentives in Incompletely Specified Environments
papers.title_zh: 不完全指定环境中的动态激励
papers.abstract_en: Consider a repeated interaction where it is unknown which of various stage games will be played each period. This framework separates the basic logic of intertemporal incentives from the requirement that any given strategy profile yields a well‐defined payoff vector. A natural solution concept is ex post perfect equilibrium: strategies must form a subgame‐perfect equilibrium for any realization of the sequence of stage games. When there is one long‐run player and others are short‐run, and public randomization is available, we can adapt the standard recursive approach to determine the maximum feasible gap between reward and punishment for the long‐run player. This allows us to identify which actions can be played in equilibrium and, assuming perfect monitoring, to fully characterize what outcome paths can arise. With multiple long‐run players or no public randomization, the approach fails; a diagnostic of this failure is that optimal penal codes may no longer exist.
papers.abstract_zh: 考虑一个重复互动，其中每个时期的具体阶段游戏是未知的。这个框架将跨时期的激励基本逻辑与任何给定策略组合必须产生一个明确定义的收益向量的要求分离开来。一个自然的解决方案概念是事后完美均衡：对于阶段游戏序列的任何实现，策略必须形成一个子博弈完美均衡。当有一个长期参与者而其他人是短期参与者，并且公共随机化可用时，我们可以适应标准的递归方法来确定长期参与者奖励和惩罚之间最大可行的差距。这使我们能够识别哪些行动可以在均衡中被玩，并且假设有完美的监控，可以完全描述可能出现的结果路径。如果有多个长期参与者或没有公共随机化，这种方法就会失败；这种失败的诊断是最优惩罚代码可能不再存在。

papers.title_en: The Complexity of Multidimensional Learning in Agriculture
papers.title_zh: 农业中多维学习的复杂性
papers.abstract_en: Studies on agricultural technology adoption often focus on one input, practice, or package, which is analytically useful, but may overlook the complexities involved with multidimensional learning needed for a lot of agricultural decisions. In Kenya, we study farmers' dynamic learning (from oneself and others) and adoption decisions over six seasons after randomly inviting them to participate in agronomic research trials, comparing different combinations of inputs during three consecutive seasons. As a response to the trials, adoption increases steadily despite the absence of positive profits multiple seasons after exposure to the trials. Know‐how increases rapidly and faster for high skill farmers who experiment the most, at the cost of making new mistakes. The findings are consistent with a theoretical model with multidimensionality of input and practice decisions and differential learning from one's own experience by skills, where complementarities imply that adoption of an input requires finding how to re‐optimize other dimensions, which adds to the cost of adoption.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究农业技术采纳往往关注单一投入、实践或一揽子方案，这在分析上是有用的，但可能忽视了农业决策中多维学习所需的复杂性。在肯尼亚，我们研究了农民在随机邀请参与农艺研究试验后六个季节的动态学习（从自己和他人）和采纳决策，比较了三个连续季节中不同投入组合的效果。作为对试验的响应，尽管在接触试验后多个季节没有获得正利润，采纳仍然稳步增加。知识增长迅速，对于技能较高的农民来说增长更快，他们进行的实验最多，但代价是犯新错误。这些发现与一个理论模型一致，该模型具有投入和实践决策的多维性，以及根据技能从自己的经验中进行差异化学习，其中互补性意味着采纳一种投入需要找到如何重新优化其他维度的方法，这增加了采纳的成本。

papers.title_en: Trade and Domestic Distortions: The Case of Informality
papers.title_zh: 贸易与国内扭曲：非正规经济案例
papers.abstract_en: We examine the effects of international trade in the presence of a set of domestic distortions giving rise to informality, a prevalent phenomenon in developing countries. In our quantitative model, the informal sector arises from burdensome taxes and regulations that are imperfectly enforced by the government. In equilibrium, smaller, less productive firms face fewer distortions than larger, more productive ones, potentially leading to substantial misallocation. We show that in settings with a large informal sector, the gains from trade are significantly amplified, as reductions in trade barriers imply a reallocation of resources from initially less distorted to more distorted firms. We confirm findings from earlier reduced‐form studies that the informal sector mitigates the impact of negative labor demand shocks on unemployment. Nonetheless, the informal sector can exacerbate the adverse real income effects of economic downturns, amplifying misallocation. Last, our research sheds light on the relationship between trade openness and cross‐firm wage inequality.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在存在导致非正规性的一系列国内扭曲的情况下国际贸易的影响，非正规性是发展中国家普遍存在的现象。在我们的定量模型中，非正规部门是由政府不完全执行的繁重税收和法规产生的。在均衡状态下，规模较小、生产率较低的企业面临的扭曲比规模较大、生产率较高的企业要少，可能导致严重的资源错配。我们展示了在非正规部门较大的背景下，贸易收益显著增加，因为贸易壁垒的降低意味着资源从最初扭曲较小的企业重新分配到扭曲较大的企业。我们证实了早期简化形式研究的发现，即非正规部门减轻了负面劳动力需求冲击对失业的影响。尽管如此，非正规部门可能加剧经济衰退对实际收入的不利影响，放大错配。最后，我们的研究揭示了贸易开放度与企业间工资不平等之间的关系。

papers.title_en: Optimally‐Transported Generalized Method of Moments
papers.title_zh: 最优传输广义矩估计法
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel optimal transport‐based version of the Generalized Method of Moment (GMM). Instead of handling overidentification by reweighting the data to satisfy the moment conditions (as in Generalized Empirical Likelihood methods), this method proceeds by allowing for errors in the variables of the least mean‐square magnitude necessary to simultaneously satisfy all moment conditions. This approach, based on the notions of optimal transport and Wasserstein metric, aims to address the problem of assigning a logical interpretation to GMM results even when overidentification tests reject the null, a situation that cannot always be avoided in applications. We illustrate the method by revisiting Duranton, Morrow and Turner's (2014) study of the relationship between a city's exports and the extent of its transportation infrastructure. Our results corroborate theirs under weaker assumptions and provide insight into the error structure of the variables.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于最优传输的广义矩估计（GMM）新版本。与通过重新加权数据以满足矩条件来处理过度识别问题（如在广义经验似然方法中）不同，这种方法通过允许变量误差以最小二乘幅度同时满足所有矩条件。这种方法基于最优传输和Wasserstein度量的概念，旨在解决即使在过度识别检验拒绝零假设时，为GMM结果赋予逻辑解释的问题，这种情况在应用中并不总是可以避免的。我们通过重新审视Duranton、Morrow和Turner（2014）关于城市出口与交通基础设施范围之间关系的研究来说明这种方法。我们的结果在更弱的假设下证实了他们的发现，并提供了对变量误差结构的见解。

papers.title_en: Food Policy in a Warming World
papers.title_zh: 全球变暖下的食品政策
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies how governments intervene in agricultural markets to reshape the economic consequences of climate extremes. We construct a global dataset of agricultural policies and extreme heat exposure by country and crop since 1980. Extreme heat shocks to domestic production lead to policies that assist consumers by lowering domestic food prices. This effect is persistent, primarily implemented via border policies, and stronger during election years. Shocks to foreign production induce the opposite response: policies that assist producers by raising prices. These findings can be rationalized by a model in which governments use agricultural policy to redistribute among domestic interest groups. Our estimates imply that policy responses shield domestic consumers, while exacerbating losses for domestic producers and foreign consumers. Policy responses have regressive consequences globally, disproportionately harming poor and heat‐exposed countries.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了政府如何干预农业市场以重塑气候极端事件的经济后果。我们构建了一个自1980年以来按国家和作物划分的全球农业政策和极端热暴露数据集。国内生产受到极端热冲击导致的政策会通过降低国内食品价格来帮助消费者。这种效应是持久的，主要通过边境政策实施，并在选举年更为强烈。外国生产受到的冲击则引起相反的反应：通过提高价格来帮助生产者的政策。这些发现可以通过一个模型来合理化，其中政府使用农业政策在国内利益集团之间重新分配。我们的估计意味着政策反应保护了国内消费者，同时加剧了国内生产者和外国消费者的损失。政策反应在全球范围内产生了倒退性后果，不成比例地伤害了贫困和受热暴露的国家。

papers.title_en: An Experimental Evaluation of Deferred Acceptance: Evidence From Over 100 Army Officer Labor Markets
papers.title_zh: 标题：延迟接受机制的实验评估：来自100多个军官劳动市场的证据
papers.abstract_en: Internal labor markets are increasingly important for matching workers to jobs within organizations. We present evidence from a randomized trial that compares matching workers to jobs using the deferred acceptance (DA) algorithm to the traditional manager‐directed matching process. Our setting is the U.S. Army's internal labor market, which matches over 14,000 officers to units annually. We find that DA reduces administrative burden and increases match quality as measured by reduced justified envy, increased truthful preference reporting, and officers' and units' preferences over their matches. The overall impact of DA on officer retention and performance in the two years after officers started their new jobs is limited by strategic preference coordination between officers and units. However, DA leads to significant improvements in officer retention and promotions in markets with inexperienced managers. Our findings suggest that cross‐market communication between agents in internal labor markets can attenuate the benefits of strategyproof matching algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 内部劳动市场在组织内匹配工人和工作方面越来越重要。我们提供了一项随机试验的证据，该试验比较了使用延迟接受（DA）算法匹配工人和工作与传统的经理指导匹配过程。我们的研究背景是美国军队的内部劳动市场，该市场每年将超过14,000名军官匹配到单位。我们发现，DA减少了行政负担，并通过减少合理的嫉妒、增加真实的偏好报告以及军官和单位对他们匹配的偏好来提高匹配质量。DA对军官在开始新工作后两年内的留存和表现的整体影响受到军官和单位之间策略性偏好协调的限制。然而，DA在有经验不足经理的市场中导致军官留存和晋升的显著改善。我们的发现表明，内部劳动市场中跨市场沟通可以在一定程度上削弱策略证明匹配算法的好处。

papers.title_en: Search Direction: Position Externalities and Position Auction Bias
papers.title_zh: 搜索方向：位置外部性与位置拍卖偏差
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We formulate a tractable model of pricing under directed search with heterogeneous firm demands. Demand characteristics drive bids in a position auction and enable us to bridge insights from the ordered search literature to those in the position auction literature. Equilibrium pricing implies that the marginal consumer’s surplus decreases down the search order, so consumers optimally follow the firms’ position ordering. A firm suffers from “business stealing” by firms that precede it and “search appeal” from subsequent firms. We find rankings that achieve the maximal joint profit or consumer surplus by constructing firm-specific scores. A generalized second price auction for positions endogenizes equilibrium orders and bids are driven by position externalities that impact incremental profit from switching positions. The joint profit maximization order is upheld when firm heterogeneity concerns mostly their mark-up potentials. But the consumer welfare order is robust when firms differ mostly over their potential market sizes.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们构建了一个在异质性企业需求下有向搜索定价的可行模型。需求特征驱动位置拍卖中的出价，并使我们能够将有序搜索文献中的见解与位置拍卖文献中的见解联系起来。均衡定价意味着边际消费者的剩余随着搜索顺序的下降而减少，因此消费者最优地遵循企业的排序。企业会因为排在它前面的企业而遭受“生意窃取”，并从排在它后面的企业那里获得“搜索吸引力”。我们通过构建企业特定的评分来找到实现最大联合利润或消费者剩余的排名。位置的广义第二价格拍卖内生化了均衡顺序，出价受到影响从交换位置中获得的增量利润的位置外部性的影响。当企业异质性主要涉及它们的加价潜力时，维持了联合利润最大化顺序。但是，当企业主要在它们的潜在市场规模上有所不同时，消费者福利顺序是稳健的。

papers.title_en: Quantifying the Benefits of Labour Mobility in a Currency Union
papers.title_zh: 货币联盟中劳动力流动性益处的量化
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Unemployment differentials are greater between countries in the euro area than between U.S. states. In both regions, net migration responds to unemployment differentials, though the response is smaller in the euro area compared to the U.S. We use a multi-country DSGE model with cross-border migration to quantify Mundell’s hypothesis that labour mobility could substitute for independent monetary policy in a currency union. While not as effective as independent monetary policy, increased labour mobility reduces business cycle fluctuations for most countries in the euro area. However, Mundell’s conjecture does not hold uniformly. For countries that primarily face demand shocks, labour mobility stabilizes inflation and unemployment and improves welfare. If supply shocks are dominant however, labour mobility increases the cost of being in a currency union by magnifying inflation volatility.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：欧元区国家之间的失业率差异大于美国各州之间的差异。在这两个地区，净移民对失业率差异做出反应，尽管欧元区的反应比美国小。我们使用一个包含跨境移民的多国DSGE模型来量化蒙代尔的假设，即劳动力流动性可以替代货币联盟中的独立货币政策。虽然劳动力流动性不如独立的货币政策有效，但它减少了欧元区大多数国家的商业周期波动。然而，蒙代尔的猜想并不普遍成立。对于那些主要面临需求冲击的国家，劳动力流动性稳定了通货膨胀和失业率，并提高了福利。然而，如果供应冲击占主导地位，劳动力流动性通过放大通货膨胀波动增加了货币联盟的成本。

papers.title_en: Bargaining Foundations for the Outside Option Principle
papers.title_zh: 外部选择原则的谈判基础
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We study a bargaining game in which a seller can trade with one of two buyers, who have values h and l (h>l). The outside option principle (OOP) predicts that, as players become patient, the seller trades with the high-value buyer with probability converging to 1 at a price converging to max(h/2,l). While this prediction is supported by the Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE), a wide range of trading outcomes may emerge in subgame perfect equilibria (SPEs): in the patient limit, the seller can obtain any price in the interval [h/2,h] (and no other); moreover, allocative inefficiency and costly delay are possible. We propose equilibrium refinements less restrictive than Markov behavior that guarantee trading outcomes consistent with the OOP. One refinement requires that a buyer’s relative probability of trade does not increase dramatically following a failed negotiation with that buyer. Another refinement posits that the seller does not approach a buyer hoping that negotiations fail. SPEs satisfying both refinements conform with the OOP (but need not be MPEs). Our benchmark model features strategic matching by the seller. We provide a parallel analysis for the random matching protocol. Under random matching, prices in SPEs may also rise above and fall below l, but have a narrower range. A refinement particular to this protocol that restores the OOP requires that a random mismatch should not impact the seller excessively.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了一个议价博弈，其中卖家可以与两个买家中的一个进行交易，这两个买家的价值分别为h和l（h>l）。外部选择原则（OOP）预测，随着参与者变得更加耐心，卖家与高价值买家交易的概率趋于1，价格趋于max(h/2,l)。尽管这一预测得到了马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）的支持，但在子博弈完美均衡（SPEs）中可能出现广泛的交易结果：在耐心极限情况下，卖家可以获得任何价格在区间[h/2,h]内（没有其他）；此外，配置效率低下和成本高昂的延迟是可能的。我们提出了比马尔可夫行为限制性更小的均衡细化，以确保与OOP一致的交易结果。一种细化要求，在与该买家的谈判失败后，买家的相对交易概率不会急剧增加。另一种细化假设卖家不会接近一个买家，希望谈判失败。满足这两种细化的SPEs与OOP一致（但不一定是MPEs）。我们的基准模型以卖家的战略匹配为特征。我们为随机匹配协议提供了并行分析。在随机匹配下，SPEs中的价格也可能高于和低于l，但范围更窄。恢复OOP的特定细化要求随机不匹配不应过度影响卖家。

papers.title_en: Endogenous Clustering and Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibrium
papers.title_zh: 内生集聚与类比预期均衡
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Normal-form two-player games are categorized by players into K analogy classes so as to minimize the prediction error about the behaviour of the opponent. This results in Clustered Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibria in which strategies are analogy-based expectation equilibria given the analogy partitions and analogy partitions minimize the prediction errors given the strategies. We distinguish between environments with self-repelling analogy partitions in which some mixing over partitions is required and environments with self-attractive partitions in which several analogy partitions can arise, thereby suggesting new channels of belief heterogeneity and equilibrium multiplicity. Various economic applications are discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：标准形式的两人博弈根据玩家被划分为K类类比类别，以最小化对对手行为的预测误差。这导致了基于类比的预期均衡，其中策略是基于类比划分的预期均衡，并且类比划分在给定策略的情况下最小化预测误差。我们区分了具有自排斥类比划分的环境，在这些环境中需要在划分上进行一些混合，以及具有自吸引划分的环境，在这些环境中可以产生多个类比划分，从而提出了信念异质性和均衡多重性的新渠道。讨论了各种经济应用。

papers.title_en: Good Dispersion, Bad Dispersion
papers.title_zh: 好的分散，坏的分散
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We document that most dispersion in marginal revenue products of inputs occurs across plants within firms rather than between firms. This is commonly thought to reflect misallocation: dispersion is “bad”. However, we show that eliminating frictions hampering internal capital markets in a multi-plant firm model may in fact increase productivity dispersion and raise output: dispersion can be “good”. This arises as firms optimally stagger investment activity across their plants over time to avoid raising costly external finance, instead relying on reallocating internal funds. The staggering in turn generates dispersion in marginal revenue products. We use U.S. Census data on multi-plant manufacturing firms to provide empirical evidence for the model mechanism and show a quantitatively important role for good dispersion. Since there is less scope for good dispersion in emerging economies, the difference in the degree of misallocation between emerging and developed economies looks more pronounced than previously thought.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们记录了大多数投入要素边际收益产品的差异发生在企业内部的工厂之间，而不是企业之间。这通常被认为是资源错配：差异是“坏”的。然而，我们展示了在多工厂企业模型中消除阻碍内部资本市场的摩擦实际上可能增加生产率差异并提高产出：差异可以是“好”的。这是因为企业最优地在不同时间对其工厂的投资活动进行交错，以避免筹集成本高昂的外部资金，而是依赖于重新分配内部资金。这种交错反过来又产生了边际收益产品的差异。我们使用美国人口普查局关于多工厂制造企业的数据为模型机制提供实证证据，并展示了好差异在数量上的重要角色。由于在新兴经济体中好差异的范围较小，新兴经济体与发展中经济体之间错配程度的差异看起来比之前认为的更为明显。

papers.title_en: Demand Shocks as Technology Shocks
papers.title_zh: 需求冲击作为技术冲击
papers.abstract_en: Abstract We provide a macroeconomic theory where demand for goods has a productive role. A search friction prevents perfect matching between producers and potential customers. Larger demand induces more search, which, in turn, increases GDP and measured total factor productivity (TFP). We embed the product-market friction in a standard neoclassical model and estimate it using Bayesian techniques. Business cycles are driven by preference shocks, true technology shocks, and investment-specific shocks. Preference shocks have qualitatively similar effects as true productivity shocks. These shocks account for a large share of the fluctuations in consumption, GDP, and measured TFP and can be identified using shopping time data.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们提供了一个宏观经济理论，其中商品需求具有生产性作用。搜索摩擦阻碍了生产者与潜在客户之间的完美匹配。更大的需求促使更多的搜索，进而增加GDP和测量的全要素生产率（TFP）。我们将产品市场摩擦嵌入到标准的新古典模型中，并使用贝叶斯技术进行估计。商业周期由偏好冲击、真实技术冲击和投资特定冲击驱动。偏好冲击对消费、GDP和测量的TFP波动的影响与真实生产率冲击类似，这些冲击占波动的很大一部分，并且可以使用购物时间数据进行识别。

papers.title_en: Pseudo Lindahl Equilibrium as a Collective Choice Rule
papers.title_zh: 伪林达尔均衡作为集体选择规则
papers.abstract_en: Abstract A collective choice problem specifies a finite set of alternatives from which a group of expected utility maximizers must choose. We associate a collective pseudo market with every collective choice problem and establish the existence and efficiency of pseudo Lindahl equilibrium (PLE) allocations. We also associate a cooperative bargaining problem with every collective choice problem and define a set-valued solution concept, the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set where ω is a vector of welfare weights. We provide axioms that characterize the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set. Our main result shows that ω-weighted Nash bargaining set payoffs are also the PLE payoffs of the corresponding collective pseudo market with the same utility functions and incomes ω. We define a pseudo core for collective pseudo markets and show that pseudo Lindahl equilibria are in the pseudo core. We characterize the set of PLE outcomes of discrete allocation problems and show that they contain the set of pseudo Walrasian equilibrium outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：集体选择问题指定了一组有限的备选方案，预期效用最大化者必须从中选择。我们为每个集体选择问题关联一个集体伪市场，并确立了伪林达尔均衡（PLE）分配的存在性和效率。我们还为每个集体选择问题关联一个合作谈判问题，并定义了一个集合值解概念，即ω加权纳什谈判集，其中ω是福利权重的向量。我们提供了表征ω加权纳什谈判集的公理。我们的主要结果表明，ω加权纳什谈判集的收益也是相应集体伪市场中具有相同效用函数和收入ω的PLE收益。我们为集体伪市场定义了一个伪核心，并表明伪林达尔均衡在伪核心中。我们表征了离散分配问题的PLE结果集，并表明它们包含了伪瓦尔拉斯均衡结果集。

papers.title_en: Hiring as Exploration
papers.title_zh: 招聘作为探索
papers.abstract_en: Abstract This article views hiring as a contextual bandit problem: to find the best workers over time, firms must balance “exploitation” (selecting from groups with proven track records) with “exploration” (selecting from under-represented groups to learn about quality). Yet modern hiring algorithms, based on supervised learning approaches, are designed solely for exploitation. Instead, we build a resume screening algorithm that values exploration by evaluating candidates according to their statistical upside potential. Using data from professional services recruiting within a Fortune 500 firm, we show that this approach improves the quality (as measured by eventual hiring rates) of candidates selected for an interview, while also increasing demographic diversity, relative to the firm’s existing practices. The same is not true for traditional supervised learning-based algorithms, which improve hiring rates but select far fewer Black and Hispanic applicants. Together, our results highlight the importance of incorporating exploration in developing decision-making algorithms that are potentially both more efficient and equitable.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文将招聘视为一种上下文多臂老虎机问题：为了随时间找到最佳员工，公司必须在“利用”（从有良好业绩记录的群体中选择）与“探索”（从代表性不足的群体中选择以了解质量）之间取得平衡。然而，现代招聘算法基于监督学习方法，仅设计用于利用。相反，我们构建了一个重视探索的简历筛选算法，通过评估候选人的统计上升潜力来评估他们。利用财富500强公司专业服务招聘的数据，我们展示了这种方法提高了被选中面试候选人的质量（以最终招聘率衡量），同时也增加了人口统计多样性，相对于公司现有的做法。传统的基于监督学习的算法并非如此，它们提高了招聘率，但选择的黑人和西班牙裔申请者要少得多。总体而言，我们的结果强调了在开发可能更高效和公平的决策算法时，纳入探索的重要性。

papers.title_en: Surviving Childhood: Effects of Removing a Child From Home
papers.title_zh: 儿童生存：将儿童从家中移除的影响
papers.abstract_en: Abstract This paper studies the effects of the court-ordered removal of children from home on health, crime, and education. To isolate causal effects, I exploit quasi-random variation in judge assignment together with across-judge variation in the tendency to favour removal in an instrumental variable design. Using a novel data set (N=26,579) based on Swedish court documents that I transcribe and link with detailed register data, I find that court-ordered out-of-home placement has large adverse effects on the mortality of the marginal child. These effects are primarily driven by suicides that occur while the removed child is still placed in out-of-home care. Removal also causes an increase in hospitalizations for mental illness and non-narcotic crimes. There is little evidence of adverse health effects for birth parents. I explore potential explanations for the detrimental effects on child health. Adverse care conditions and peer exposure appear to be important channels.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了法院命令将儿童从家中移除对健康、犯罪和教育的影响。为了分离因果效应，我利用法官分配中的准随机变化以及法官间倾向于支持移除的差异，在工具变量设计中进行研究。利用基于瑞典法院文件的新颖数据集（N=26,579），我转录并将其与详细的注册数据链接，发现法院命令的离家安置对边缘儿童的死亡率有较大的不利影响。这些影响主要是由被移除儿童仍在离家护理期间发生的自杀行为所驱动的。移除还导致因精神疾病和非麻醉品犯罪而住院的增加。对于亲生父母，几乎没有不利健康影响的证据。我探讨了对儿童健康产生不利影响的潜在解释。不利的护理条件和同伴暴露似乎是重要的渠道。

papers.title_en: Racial Discrimination and the Social Contract: Evidence from U.S. Army Enlistment During WWII
papers.title_zh: 种族歧视与社会契约：二战期间美国军队征兵的证据
papers.abstract_en: Abstract This paper documents that the Pearl Harbor attack triggered a sharp increase in volunteer enlistment rates of American men, the magnitude of the increase was smaller for Black men than for White men and the Black–White gap was larger in counties with higher levels of racial discrimination. The results suggest that political exclusion and discrimination can undermine support for the government during critical times such as war.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文记录了珍珠港袭击导致美国男性志愿者入伍率急剧上升，黑人男性的增幅小于白人男性，且在种族歧视程度较高的县，黑人与白人之间的差距更大。结果表明，在战争等关键时刻，政治排斥和歧视可能会削弱对政府的支持。

papers.title_en: Extreme Categories and Overreaction to News
papers.title_zh: 极端分类与对新闻的过度反应
papers.abstract_en: Abstract What characteristics of news generate over-or-underreaction? We study the asset-pricing consequences of diagnostic expectations, a model of belief formation based on the representativeness heuristic, in a setting where news events are drawn from categories with extreme distributions of fundamentals. Our model predicts greater overreaction to news belonging to categories with more extreme outliers, or tail events. We test our theory on a comprehensive database of corporate news that includes news from twenty-four different categories, including earnings announcements, product launches, mergers and acquisition, business expansions, and client-related news. We find theory-consistent heterogeneity in investor reaction to news, with more overreaction in the form of greater post-announcement return reversals and trading volume for news categories with more extreme distributions of fundamentals.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：哪些新闻特征会导致过度或不足反应？我们研究了基于代表性启发式的信念形成模型——诊断性预期——在新闻事件来自具有极端基本面分布的类别时的资产定价后果。我们的模型预测，对于属于具有更多极端异常值或尾部事件的类别的新闻，会有更大的过度反应。我们在包含二十四个不同类别的企业新闻的全面数据库上测试了我们的理论，包括盈利公告、产品发布、并购、业务扩张和客户相关新闻。我们发现，投资者对新闻的反应与理论一致，具有更大的异质性，对于具有更极端基本面分布的新闻类别，表现为更大的公告后回报反转和交易量。

papers.title_en: The Effects of Racial Segregation on Intergenerational Mobility: Evidence from Historical Railroad Placement
papers.title_zh: 种族隔离对代际流动性的影响：来自历史铁路布局的证据
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides new evidence on the causal impacts of citywide racial segregation on intergenerational mobility. We use an instrumental variable approach that relies on plausibly exogenous variation in segregation due to the arrangement of railroad tracks in the nineteenth century. Our analysis finds that higher segregation reduces upward mobility for Black children from households across the income distribution and White children from low-income households. Moreover, segregation lowers academic achievement while increasing incarceration and teenage birth rates. An analysis of mechanisms shows that segregation reduces government spending, weakens support for antipoverty policies, and increases racially conservative attitudes among White residents. (JEL I38, J13, J15, J62, N32, N72, R30)
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于城市范围内种族隔离对代际流动性因果影响的新证据。我们采用了一种工具变量方法，该方法依赖于19世纪铁路轨道布局导致的种族隔离的外生变化。我们的分析发现，更高的隔离程度降低了黑人儿童和低收入家庭白人儿童的向上流动性。此外，隔离降低了学术成就，同时增加了监禁率和青少年生育率。对机制的分析表明，隔离减少了政府支出，削弱了对反贫困政策的支持，并增加了白人居民中的种族保守态度。（JEL I38, J13, J15, J62, N32, N72, R30）

papers.title_en: Release, Detain, or Surveil? The Effect of Electronic Monitoring on Defendant Outcomes
papers.title_zh: 释放、拘留还是监控？电子监控对被告人结果的影响
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of pretrial electronic monitoring (EM) relative to both pretrial release and pretrial detention (jail). EM often involves a defendant wearing an electronic bracelet, which aims to reduce pretrial misconduct at a low cost. Using the quasi-random assignment of bond court judges, I estimate the effect of EM versus release and EM versus detention on pretrial misconduct, case outcomes, future recidivism, and aggregate total costs. Results indicate that EM reduces overall costs relative to detention. However, EM does not prevent enough high-cost crime to justify its use relative to release. (JEL K14, K41, K42)
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了审前电子监控（EM）相对于审前释放和审前拘留（监狱）的效果。EM通常涉及被告佩戴电子手环，旨在以低成本减少审前不当行为。利用债券法院法官的准随机分配，我估计了EM与释放相比以及EM与拘留相比对审前不当行为、案件结果、未来再犯和总成本的影响。结果表明，与拘留相比，EM降低了总体成本。然而，EM未能防止足够的高成本犯罪，以证明其相对于释放的使用是合理的。（JEL K14，K41，K42）

papers.title_en: Ethnic Diversity, Historical Economic Exchange, and Development: Evidence from Andean Peru
papers.title_zh: 种族多样性、历史经济交流与发展：来自安第斯山脉秘鲁的证据
papers.abstract_en: Is ethnic diversity good or bad for economic development? Most studies find corrosive effects. This paper shows that historical exposure to economic exchange can mitigate these effects in the long run. I collect data from a natural experiment of Peru's colonial history: the forced resettlement of native populations in the sixteenth century. Where the resettlement concentrated ethnically diverse populations with a history of internal crop exchange, contemporary populations perform better systematically. Additional evidence suggests that prior experience with mutually beneficial crop exchange shaped more open attitudes toward out-group members. Economic complementarities helped sustain long-run, market-oriented cooperation and local trade. (JEL F54, J15, N16, N36, N56, O15, Q12)
papers.abstract_zh: 种族多样性对经济发展是好是坏？大多数研究发现其具有腐蚀性影响。本文表明，历史上的经济交流接触可以在长期内减轻这些影响。我收集了秘鲁殖民历史的自然实验数据：16世纪对土著人口的强制重新安置。在重新安置集中了具有内部作物交换历史的种族多样性人口的地方，当代人口的表现系统性地更好。额外的证据表明，先前的经验与互惠互利的作物交换塑造了对外部群体成员更开放的态度。经济互补性有助于维持长期的、面向市场的合作和地方贸易。（JEL F54, J15, N16, N36, N56, O15, Q12）

papers.title_en: Wealth, Marriage, and Sex Selection
papers.title_zh: 财富、婚姻与性别选择
papers.abstract_en: Two mechanisms have been proposed to explain sex selection in India: son preference, in which parents desire a male heir, and daughter aversion, in which dowry payments make parents worse off with girls. Our model incorporates both mechanisms, providing microfoundations, based on the organization of the marriage institution, for daughter aversion. Marital matching, sex selection, and dowries are jointly determined in the model, whose implications are tested on a representative sample of rural households. Simulations of the model indicate that existing policies targeting daughter aversion might exacerbate the problem, while identifying other policies that could be effective. (JEL D31, G51, J12, J16, O12, O18, Z13)
papers.abstract_zh: 提出了两种机制来解释印度的性别选择：儿子偏好，即父母希望有男性继承人，以及女儿厌恶，即嫁妆支付使父母因有女儿而境况更糟。我们的模型结合了这两种机制，基于婚姻制度的组织提供了女儿厌恶的微观基础。在模型中，婚姻匹配、性别选择和嫁妆是共同决定的，其含义在代表性的农村家庭样本上进行了测试。对模型的模拟表明，针对女儿厌恶的现有政策可能加剧问题，同时识别了其他可能有效的政策。（JEL D31, G51, J12, J16, O12, O18, Z13）

papers.title_en: The Long-Term Impacts of Mixing the Rich and Poor: Evidence from Conscript Dorms
papers.title_zh: 贫富混合的长期影响：来自征兵宿舍的证据
papers.abstract_en: To what extent is economic success determined by with whom individuals interact socially? We tackle this question by exploiting a large-scale natural experiment in the Finnish conscription. Our research design is based on the alphabetization of dorms, which is shown to induce as good as random variation in peer composition. Dormmates from high-income families have a positive impact on earnings, with the largest effect among individuals from high-income families. For them, a one standard deviation increase in dormmates' parental income increases long-term earnings by 5.7 percent. The results support labor market networks among the rich as the key mechanism. (JEL D12, D31, G51, I32, J31, J45)
papers.abstract_zh: 个人在社会交往中与谁互动在多大程度上决定了经济成功？我们通过利用芬兰征兵中的大规模自然实验来解决这个问题。我们的研究设计基于宿舍的字母排序，这被证明可以引起同伴组成的随机变化。来自高收入家庭的室友对收入有积极影响，其中对来自高收入家庭的个体影响最大。对他们来说，室友父母收入每增加一个标准差，长期收入就增加5.7%。结果支持富人之间的劳动市场网络是关键机制。（JEL D12, D31, G51, I32, J31, J45）

papers.title_en: Black Lives: The High Cost of Segregation
papers.title_zh: 黑人生命：隔离的高昂代价
papers.abstract_en: Exploiting the arrangement of railroad tracks in northern cities, we explore the extent to which segregation impacts homicide victimization by race. Our results reveal a robust positive relationship between segregation and non-White homicide victimization. In addition, we find a decrease in public provisions, as highly segregated locations generate fewer revenues and have lower public expenditures. Our findings suggest that White flight and segregation deplete the local tax base, leading to urban decay and higher crime, resulting in the loss of non-White lives. (JEL H71, I32, J15, K42, R23)
papers.abstract_zh: 利用北方城市的铁路轨道布局，我们探讨了种族隔离对不同种族凶杀受害者的影响程度。我们的结果显示，种族隔离与非白人凶杀受害者之间存在强烈的正相关关系。此外，我们发现公共供给减少，因为高度隔离的地区产生的收入更少，公共支出也更低。我们的发现表明，白人外流和种族隔离消耗了当地的税基，导致城市衰败和犯罪率上升，最终导致非白人生命的丧失。（JEL H71, I32, J15, K42, R23）

papers.title_en: Sweeping up Gangs: The Effects of Tough-on-Crime Policies from a Network Approach
papers.title_zh: 打击犯罪团伙：从网络视角看严厉犯罪政策的影响
papers.abstract_en: Globally, gang proliferation is fought primarily through sweeps. This paper uses a difference-in-differences strategy to examine their causal impact on crime for arrested individuals and their peers. Analysis focuses on the Metropolitan Area of Barcelona, which underwent a notable policy shift. Findings reveal significant crime reductions among those arrested and their peers of 85 percent and 31 percent, respectively. Evidence suggests the first stems from incapacitation and the second from less criminal environment. A counterfactual exercise suggests that broader targeting of key players could have reduced crime by 43 percentage points more. This implies network analysis could enhance policy formulation. (JEL C31, H56, K14, K42, Z18)
papers.abstract_zh: 在全球范围内，打击团伙扩散主要是通过大规模扫荡行动。本文采用双重差分策略来检验这些行动对被捕个体及其同伙犯罪行为的因果影响。分析重点放在巴塞罗那大都市区，该地区经历了显著的政策转变。研究结果显示，被捕个体及其同伙的犯罪率分别下降了85%和31%。证据表明，前者主要源于犯罪分子的监禁，后者则源于犯罪环境的减少。一个反事实的模拟表明，更广泛地针对关键人物可能会使犯罪率额外降低43个百分点。这意味着网络分析可以增强政策制定。（JEL C31, H56, K14, K42, Z18）

papers.title_en: Are Complementary Policies Substitutes? Evidence from R&D Subsidies in the United Kingdom
papers.title_zh: 互补政策是替代品吗？来自英国研发补贴的证据
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies whether grants and tax incentives for private R&D are complements or substitutes. I use multiple quasi-experimental research designs to examine firms in the United Kingdom and find that increasing tax credit generosity substantially enhances the effect of grant funding on R&D for small firms, suggesting that the instruments are complements. Financial constraints are likely at play. The effects are strongest for firms that appear constrained, and the combination of policies increases R&D “entry.” Furthermore, I find that the instruments are substitutes for larger firms, which are usually less constrained. Some alternative explanations can be ruled out. (JEL D22, H25, H81, L25, O31, O38)
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了私人研发的补贴和税收激励是互补还是替代关系。我采用多种准实验研究设计，检验了英国的公司，发现增加税收抵免的慷慨程度显著增强了对小公司研发的补贴资金效应，表明这些工具是互补的。财务约束可能是关键因素。对于看似受约束的公司，效应最强，政策组合增加了研发“进入”。此外，我发现对于通常受约束较少的大公司，这些工具是替代品。一些替代性解释可以被排除。（JEL D22, H25, H81, L25, O31, O38）

papers.title_en: Invisible Wounds: How Mental Disability Benefits Shape Veteran Well-Being
papers.title_zh: 隐形创伤：精神残疾福利如何塑造退伍军人福祉
papers.abstract_en: We study impacts of VA disability compensation on the health and well-being of the large and rapidly growing population of veterans claiming mental disorders. We leverage quasi-random assignment of veterans to medical examiners with varying assessing tendencies. An additional $1,000 per year decreases food insecurity and homelessness by 4.1 and 1.3 percent over 5 years. Health care utilization increases, with greater engagement in preventive care. We estimate precise null average effects on health and mortality. Those on the margin of claim denial experience worse outcomes on average than other applicants, with suggestive evidence of large treatment effects for this subpopulation. (JEL I12, I31, I38, J14)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了退伍军人残疾补偿对声称患有精神障碍的庞大且迅速增长的退伍军人群体的健康和福祉的影响。我们利用退伍军人被准随机分配给评估倾向不同的医疗检查员。每年额外1000美元可以在未来5年内将食物不安全和无家可归的比例分别降低4.1%和1.3%。医疗保健利用率增加，预防性护理的参与度更高。我们估计对健康和死亡率的平均效应为精确的零。那些处于索赔拒绝边缘的人平均比其他申请者的结果更差，对于这一亚群体有大的处理效应的暗示性证据。（JEL I12, I31, I38, J14）

papers.title_en: Connections during Democratic Transitions: Insights from the Political Purge in Post-WWII France
papers.title_zh: 民主转型期间的联系：二战后法国政治清洗的启示
papers.abstract_en: We examine how connections shaped transitional justice during France’s post-WWII democratic transition. Parliamentarians who had supported the Vichy regime faced a two-stage purge process involving two courts. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that law graduates—an influential group with ties to one of the courts—had a 10 to 14 percentage point higher acquittal rate. We analyze 17,589 documents in individual defendants’ files to explain this difference. According to this analysis, indirect connections—connections through third parties—enabled transmission of information to the judges, highlighting how connected elite groups can navigate transitions despite institutional safeguards. (JEL D72, D83, K41, N44)
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在法国二战后民主转型期间，关系如何塑造过渡正义。支持维希政权的议员面临一个涉及两个法院的两阶段清洗过程。利用双重差分策略，我们发现法学院毕业生——一个与其中一个法院有联系的有影响力的群体——的无罪释放率高出10到14个百分点。我们分析了17,589份个人被告文件中的文件，以解释这一差异。根据这一分析，间接联系——通过第三方的联系——使信息能够传递给法官，突出了有联系的精英群体如何在制度保障下驾驭转型。（JEL D72, D83, K41, N44）

papers.title_en: Multinational investment activity under policy uncertainty in host and competing countries
papers.title_zh: 东道国和竞争国家政策不确定性下的跨国投资活动
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines how economic policy uncertainty (EPU) in host and competing countries reshapes U.S. multinationals’ greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI). Using firm-destination level data from 2003 to 2021, we show that while host-country EPU deters investment, EPU in competing destinations attracts it through a spillover effect. We document a structural shift around 2015: as global EPU rose unevenly, the spillover effect from competitors became the dominant driver of investment decisions, supplanting the direct effect of host-country policy instability. Our findings indicate that in an era of heightened global uncertainty and risk, FDI allocation is governed by relative, not just absolute, policy stability. • Host-country policy uncertainty deters FDI, while competitor uncertainty attracts it. • Relative policy stability, rather than absolute levels, governs FDI flows recently. • A structural shift after 2015 made competitor uncertainty the dominant driver of FDI.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了东道国和竞争国家的经济政策不确定性（EPU）如何重塑美国跨国公司的绿地外国直接投资（FDI）。利用2003至2021年的企业-目的地层面数据，我们发现东道国EPU抑制了投资，而竞争目的地的EPU通过溢出效应吸引了投资。我们记录了2015年左右的结构性转变：随着全球EPU的不均衡上升，来自竞争者的溢出效应成为投资决策的主要驱动力，取代了东道国政策不稳定的直接影响。我们的发现表明，在全球化不确定性和风险加剧的时代，FDI配置由相对而非绝对政策稳定性决定。•东道国政策不确定性抑制FDI，而竞争者不确定性吸引FDI。•相对政策稳定性而非绝对水平，最近决定了FDI流动。•2015年后的结构性转变使竞争者不确定性成为FDI的主要驱动力。

papers.title_en: Domestic wedges and the (in)sensitivity of CPI to exchange rates
papers.title_zh: 国内楔子与CPI对汇率的（不）敏感性

papers.title_en: Real exchange rate dynamics beyond business cycles
papers.title_zh: 实际汇率动态超越商业周期
papers.abstract_en: We examine the determinants of medium-term movements in real exchange rates. Using US-UK data over the past 200 years, we find that the real exchange rate co-moves with GDP and the co-movements are significantly affected by banking crises. This relationship can be rationalized by an extension of the IRBC model with persistent productivity shocks and incomplete markets. Using a new global solution method, we demonstrate that the transmission of productivity shocks depends critically on the proximity of a national economy to its international borrowing limit. The mechanism differs from the Harrod-Balassa-Samuelson effect which does not generate these state dependent responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了实际汇率中期变动的决定因素。利用过去200年的美国-英国数据，我们发现实际汇率与GDP共同变动，且这种共同变动受到银行危机的显著影响。这种关系可以通过扩展包含持久性生产率冲击和不完全市场的IRBC模型来合理化。使用一种新的全球解决方案方法，我们证明生产率冲击的传导在很大程度上取决于一个国家经济接近其国际借款限额的程度。这种机制与不产生这些状态依赖反应的哈罗德-巴拉斯-萨缪尔森效应不同。

papers.title_en: Trade in appliances, household production, and labor force participation
papers.title_zh: 家电贸易、家庭生产与劳动力参与
papers.abstract_en: We examine how trade influences female labor supply through reductions in the prices of household appliances that substitute for domestic labor. Using a comprehensive data set from 1981 to 2017, which includes four population censuses, household surveys, and customs records from Peru, we show that labor force participation rose at the same time that appliance import prices fell. We then develop and estimate a dynamic general equilibrium model of trade and household production, to quantitatively evaluate the aggregate impact of declining appliance prices. We find that the reduction in appliance prices during the sample period leads to an increase in female labor force participation that explains one tenth of the total rise in female labor participation in Peru over the past 30 years.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了贸易如何通过降低替代家庭劳动的家用电器价格来影响女性劳动力供给。利用1981年至2017年的全面数据集，包括秘鲁的四次人口普查、家庭调查和海关记录，我们展示了劳动力参与率的上升与家用电器进口价格的下降是同步的。然后，我们开发并估计了一个贸易和家庭生产的动态一般均衡模型，以定量评估家用电器价格下降的总体影响。我们发现，在样本期间家用电器价格的降低导致女性劳动力参与率的增加，这一增加解释了过去30年秘鲁女性劳动力参与率总上升的十分之一。

papers.title_en: The global network of liquidity lines
papers.title_zh: 全球流动性网络
papers.abstract_en: At the end of 2025, there were 177 cross-border liquidity lines between central banks connecting countries that accounted for 81% of world GDP. This paper maps the evolution of these arrangements since 2000. We show that the lines form a network through which banks can indirectly obtain access to the USD even when their central bank has no agreement with the Federal Reserve. These indirect connections give the People’s Bank of China a central role and show the fragility of liquidity provision to geopolitical tensions. We present cross-country evidence that the indirect connections reduce CIP deviations at the tails, and causal evidence that liquidity lines are substitutes to FX reserves. • A new comprehensive dataset of central bank cross-border liquidity lines 2000-25. • A historical account of the evolution of liquidity lines across time and countries. • A country can indirectly access foreign liquidity even without a direct line to the source. • Indirect connections through the network are associated with lower CIP deviations. • Improvement in network access to foreign liquidity causally lowers FX reserves.
papers.abstract_zh: 到2025年底，中央银行之间共有177条跨境流动性线路，连接了占全球GDP 81%的国家。本文绘制了自2000年以来这些安排的演变。我们展示了这些线路形成了一个网络，银行即使在它们的中央银行与美联储没有协议的情况下，也可以间接获得美元。这些间接联系使中国人民银行发挥了中心作用，并显示了流动性供应对地缘政治紧张局势的脆弱性。我们提供了跨国证据，表明间接联系减少了尾部的CIP偏差，并提供了因果证据，表明流动性线路是外汇储备的替代品。• 2000-2025年中央银行跨境流动性线路的新综合数据集。• 流动性线路随时间和国家演变的历史记录。• 即使没有直接线路到源头，一个国家也可以间接获得外国流动性。• 通过网络的间接联系与较低的CIP偏差相关联。• 网络获取外国流动性的改善，因果地降低了外汇储备。

papers.title_en: Agricultural imports, labor mobility, and welfare
papers.title_zh: 农业进口、劳动力流动性与福利

papers.title_en: Structural change in sub-Saharan Africa: An open economy perspective
papers.title_zh: 标题：撒哈拉以南非洲的结构性变革：开放经济视角

papers.title_en: The local-area incidence of exporting
papers.title_zh: 地区出口发生率

papers.title_en: The US-China trade war creates jobs (elsewhere)
papers.title_zh: 美中贸易战创造（其他地方的）就业

papers.title_en: Exports and intergenerational mobility
papers.title_zh: 出口与代际流动性
papers.abstract_en: Using eight rounds of the Vietnam Household Living Standards Surveys spanning 16 years and exploiting the US-Vietnam Bilateral Trade Agreement (BTA) in 2001, we investigate the impact of this large export shock on intergenerational occupational mobility. The BTA has, on average, led to greater upward absolute occupational mobility among sons and daughters, with effects following roughly a U-shape by age for sons and an inverse-U for daughters. However, relative occupational mobility, inversely related to the gradient of the child’s occupational rank as a function of the parent’s, decreased on average as a result of the BTA, with this effect also varying across age groups. While the BTA improved occupational mobility for an average child, children born to top-ranked parents benefited disproportionately. Also, the BTA increased human capital investment in college education across genders and vocational training for sons. Furthermore, higher individual and initial province-level human capital facilitated this mobility.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用历时16年的八轮越南家庭生活水平调查数据，并利用2001年美越双边贸易协定（BTA），我们研究了这一大规模出口冲击对代际职业流动性的影响。BTA平均而言，导致子女的职业绝对流动性更大，对儿子的影响大致呈U形随年龄变化，对女儿则呈倒U形。然而，相对职业流动性，与孩子职业排名作为父母职业排名函数的梯度成反比，平均而言由于BTA而减少，这种效应也因年龄组而异。尽管BTA提高了普通儿童的职业流动性，但出生在排名最高的父母家庭的儿童受益更多。此外，BTA还增加了跨性别的大学教育人力资本投资，以及对儿子的职业培训。此外，更高水平的个人和初始省级人力资本促进了这种流动性。

papers.title_en: Estimating export-productivity cutoff contours with profit data: A novel threshold estimation approach
papers.title_zh: 利用利润数据估算出口-生产率临界轮廓：一种新的阈值估计方法
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel method to estimate firm-specific market-entry thresholds in international economics, allowing fixed costs to vary across firms alongside productivity. Our framework models market entry as an interaction between productivity and observable fixed-cost measures, extending traditional single-threshold models to ones with set-valued thresholds. Applying this approach to Chinese firm data, we estimate export-market entry thresholds as functions of domestic sales and surrogate variables for fixed costs. The results reveal substantial heterogeneity and threshold contours, challenging conventional single-threshold-point assumptions. These findings offer new insights into firm behavior and provide a foundation for further theoretical and empirical advancements in trade research.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法来估计国际经济学中企业特定的市场进入门槛，允许固定成本和生产率在不同企业之间变化。我们的框架将市场进入建模为生产率和可观察的固定成本度量之间的相互作用，将传统的单一阈值模型扩展到具有集合值阈值的模型。将这种方法应用于中国企业数据，我们估计出口市场进入门槛作为国内销售和固定成本替代变量的函数。结果揭示了巨大的异质性和阈值轮廓，挑战了传统的单一阈值点假设。这些发现为理解企业行为提供了新的见解，并为贸易研究的进一步理论和实证进展奠定了基础。

papers.title_en: The art of not being chocked: Environmental awareness, residents' responses and land transactions in China
papers.title_zh: 不被“窒息”的艺术：环境意识、居民响应与中国土地交易

papers.title_en: C'est la vie!: Mixed impacts of an edutainment television series in West Africa
papers.title_zh: 这就是生活！：西非一个教育娱乐电视系列的混合影响
papers.abstract_en: Edutainment is a promising tool for changing behavior at scale, yet little is known about how to maximize impacts. We undertake an experimental evaluation of a popular West African television series, C’est la vie!, delivered through film clubs targeted at adolescent girls and young women in rural Senegal. We examine impacts on violence against women and girls and sexual and reproductive health. Results show C’est la vie! improved knowledge on both domains three months after film clubs ended, as well as violence-related attitudes nine months later, however, had no impact on behaviors. We investigate design components intended to strengthen impacts, generally finding no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts. Our findings suggest that edutainment is an engaging way to reach viewers on sensitive themes, however more evidence is needed on how to effectively deliver edutainment content for sustained behavior change at scale. • Using a cluster randomized control trial, we evaluate a popular West African TV series. • We examine impacts on violence against women and girls (VAWG) and sexual and reproductive health (SRH). • We find short term knowledge gains in both domains and improved medium term VAWG attitudes. • We find no impact on behaviors. • We find no additional impacts from post-screening discussions, engaging men, and podcasts.
papers.abstract_zh: 教育娱乐是改变大规模行为的有前途的工具，但如何最大化影响却鲜为人知。我们对西非流行的电视剧《这就是生活！》进行了实验性评估，该剧通过针对塞内加尔农村少女和年轻女性的电影节俱乐部进行传播。我们检验了对针对妇女和女童的暴力行为以及性和生殖健康的影响。结果显示，《这就是生活！》在电影节结束后三个月提高了两个领域的知识，九个月后改善了与暴力相关的态度，但对行为没有影响。我们调查了旨在加强影响的设计要素，通常发现放映后讨论、吸引男性和播客没有额外影响。我们的发现表明，教育娱乐是吸引观众关注敏感主题的有趣方式，但需要更多证据来了解如何有效地传播教育娱乐内容，以实现大规模的持续行为改变。• 我们使用集群随机对照试验评估了一部流行的西非电视剧。• 我们检验了对针对妇女和女童的暴力行为（VAWG）和性和生殖健康（SRH）的影响。• 我们发现在两个领域都有短期知识收益和中期VAWG态度的改善。• 我们发现对行为没有影响。• 我们发现放映后讨论、吸引男性和播客没有额外影响。

papers.title_en: It will rain: The effect of information on flood preparedness in urban Mozambique
papers.title_zh: 洪水将至：信息对城市莫桑比克洪水准备的影响
papers.abstract_en: Floods are among the costliest and most recurring natural hazards. Many governments provide disaster preparedness information, but there is limited evidence of its effectiveness. Using a randomized experiment across 300 urban communities in Mozambique, I show that providing information on flood risk increased the implementation of suggested mitigation strategies, measured objectively (using a machine learning-based algorithm to detect solid waste, a major flood hazard, in over 25,000 photos) and through self-reported behaviors. Sending flood preparedness text messages proved to be at least as effective as more resource-intensive interventions that involved household visits and video screenings. Risk perception increased, particularly in lower-risk areas, suggesting that information and past experiences contribute to community preparedness by shaping perceived flood risk. These findings highlight the importance of communication in mobilizing communities for disaster risk management, even in contexts where flood risks are presumably already well-known, and underscore the potential of low-cost, scalable communication tools. • Flood preparedness information raised mitigation behavior in urban Mozambique. • Text messages were as effective as costlier video interventions. • Solid waste near drainage canals fell by 6–13 percentage points. • Machine learning from 25k photos provided objective behavior measures. • Low-cost communication tools can enhance urban climate resilience.
papers.abstract_zh: 洪水是最昂贵且最频繁发生的自然灾害之一。许多政府提供灾害准备信息，但关于其有效性的证据有限。通过在莫桑比克300个城市社区进行的随机实验，我展示了提供洪水风险信息增加了实施建议的减灾策略，这些策略通过客观测量（使用基于机器学习的算法在超过25,000张照片中检测固体废物，这是主要的洪水危害）和自我报告的行为来衡量。发送洪水准备短信被证明至少与涉及家庭访问和视频放映的更资源密集的干预措施一样有效。风险感知增加，特别是在低风险地区，这表明信息和过去的经历通过塑造感知的洪水风险，有助于社区准备。这些发现强调了沟通在动员社区进行灾害风险管理中的重要性，即使在洪水风险被认为已经众所周知的背景下，也强调了低成本、可扩展的沟通工具的潜力。• 洪水准备信息提高了莫桑比克城市地区的减灾行为。• 短信与成本更高的视频干预一样有效。• 排水渠附近的固体废物减少了6-13个百分点。• 从25k张照片中进行的机器学习提供了客观的行为测量。• 低成本的沟通工具可以增强城市气候韧性。

papers.title_en: Foreign interventions and community cohesion in times of conflict
papers.title_zh: 外干预与冲突时期的社区凝聚力
papers.abstract_en: The success of foreign interventions critically depends on cohesion within local communities, which serve as relevant partners in counterinsurgency and reconstruction efforts. Using unique data on military base locations and counterinsurgency aid in Afghanistan, I show that the presence of the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) negatively affects social cohesion, measured by support within communities, engagement with community institutions, and trust. I leverage a geographic regression discontinuity design to estimate effects of ISAF’s geographic mandate enlargement, complemented by a panel analysis that covers its operational intensification. These findings do not appear to reflect crowding-out of informal institutions by formal provision; rather, they coincide with higher insecurity and reduced confidence in local institutions, offering a plausible explanation for the observed erosion of community cohesion. These findings carry important implications for foreign policy, particularly in settings where communities compensate for gaps in formal institutional provision. • The study uses geocoded data on foreign military bases and counterinsurgency aid. • Geographic RD and panel evidence identify effects of expansion and intensity. • Foreign military presence weakened social cohesion in Afghanistan (2005–2010). • No evidence of crowding out; results linked to higher insecurity and lower confidence. • Results align with qualitative evidence from post-intervention “lessons learned”
papers.abstract_zh: 外国干预的成功在很大程度上取决于当地社区的凝聚力，这些社区在反叛乱和重建努力中扮演着相关伙伴的角色。利用阿富汗军事基地位置和反叛乱援助的独特数据，我展示了国际安全援助部队（ISAF）的存在对社会凝聚力产生了负面影响，这种凝聚力通过社区内的支持、与社区机构的参与以及信任来衡量。我利用地理回归不连续设计来估计ISAF地理任务扩大的效果，并辅以涵盖其行动强度化的面板分析。这些发现似乎并不反映非正式机构被正式提供挤出；相反，它们与更高的不安全感和对当地机构信心的降低相吻合，为观察到的社区凝聚力的侵蚀提供了一个合理的解释。这些发现对外交政策具有重要意义，特别是在社区补偿正式制度提供缺口的背景下。• 研究使用了外国军事基地和反叛乱援助的地理编码数据。• 地理RD和面板证据识别了扩张和强度的效果。• 外国军事存在削弱了阿富汗的社会凝聚力（2005-2010年）。• 没有挤出的证据；结果与更高的不安全感和更低的信心相关。• 结果与干预后“经验教训”的定性证据一致。

papers.title_en: Parental mental health and the economic preferences of the next generation
papers.title_zh: 父母心理健康与下一代的经济偏好
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides the first evidence that children's economic preferences vary systematically with parental mental health. Using experimentally elicited measures of economic preferences from more than 4,500 children in Bangladesh, we document that children of parents with indications of mental illness are less prosocial but more patient than their peers with mentally healthy parents. Attitudes toward risk remain unchanged. We discuss potential pathways through which parental mental health may influence the formation of children's preferences, documenting that children of parents with indication of mental illness assume greater responsibilities within the family, experience less parental involvement, and are exposed to a more adverse home environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了儿童经济偏好与父母心理健康系统性变化的证据。利用来自孟加拉国4500多名儿童的经济偏好实验性测量数据，我们记录了有精神健康问题迹象的父母的孩子比心理健康的父母的孩子更不亲社会但更有耐心。对风险的态度保持不变。我们讨论了父母心理健康可能影响儿童偏好形成的潜在途径，记录了有精神健康问题迹象的父母的孩子在家庭中承担更多责任，经历较少的父母参与，并暴露于更不利的家庭环境。

papers.title_en: From childhood abduction to adulthood: Enduring consequences for women in Uganda
papers.title_zh: 从童年绑架到成年：对乌干达女性持久的影响

papers.title_en: Trade, storage, and climate extremes: Theory and evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa
papers.title_zh: 贸易、储存与极端气候：来自撒哈拉以南非洲的理论与证据

papers.title_en: The phantom menace in agriculture: How lagged droughts distort input decisions and create environmental deadweight loss
papers.title_zh: 农业中的幽灵威胁：滞后干旱如何扭曲投入决策并造成环境无谓损失

papers.title_en: Revisiting the Leontief Paradox From a Value‐Added Trade Perspective
papers.title_zh: 从增加值贸易视角重新审视列昂惕夫悖论
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study revisits a well‐known thesis in international trade theory—the Leontief paradox—from a value‐added trade perspective within a global industrial linkage framework. Using the Heckscher–Ohlin model as a foundation, this paper employs world input–output tables and socioeconomic accounts compiled by the European Union to calculate the value added embodied in bilateral trade for specific economies. The analysis computes the capital‐to‐labor ratios of all traded goods for these economies from 2000 to 2014, aiming to identify the potential existence of the Leontief paradox. Our findings reveal that the Leontief paradox appears in many instances in the United States, especially within the services sector. However, when the value‐added trade concept is applied, the paradox is observed only in a few bilateral cases in the services sector. By contrast, the Leontief paradox is almost nonexistent in India, as a developing country with an abundant labor endowment, whether from a conventional trade perspective or a value‐added trade one is used.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究从全球产业联系框架中的价值增加贸易视角重新审视国际贸易理论中一个著名的论题——列昂惕夫悖论。本文以赫克歇尔-俄林模型为基础，利用欧盟编制的世界投入产出表和社会经济账户，计算特定经济体双边贸易中所包含的价值增加。分析计算了2000年至2014年这些经济体所有贸易商品的资本-劳动比率，旨在识别列昂惕夫悖论的潜在存在。我们的发现揭示了列昂惕夫悖论在美国许多情况下都会出现，特别是在服务业领域。然而，当应用价值增加贸易概念时，悖论仅在服务业的少数双边案例中被观察到。相比之下，作为一个拥有丰富劳动力禀赋的发展中国家，印度几乎不存在列昂惕夫悖论，无论是从传统贸易视角还是价值增加贸易视角来看。

papers.title_en: The Impact of Foreign Direct Investment on Firms' Cash Holdings: Evidence From China
papers.title_zh: 外商直接投资对企业现金持有的影响：来自中国的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This paper investigates how foreign direct investment (FDI) affects firms' cash holdings in manufacturing sectors by taking the plausibly exogenous shock of FDI liberalization in 2002 as an instrumental variable. Using data from the Chinese annual survey of industrial firms from 1998 to 2007, it is found that a 1% increase in industry‐level FDI decreases firms' cash holdings by 7.10% on average. Two explanations of the effect of FDI, that is, investment squeezing and financial constraint alleviation, are explored. Both mechanisms lead to a decrease in firms' cash holdings. In contrast to the effect of horizontal FDI, vertical FDI sourced from upstream industries exerts a positive effect on firms' cash holdings. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses suggest that the reduction in cash holdings caused by FDI inflows mainly affects smaller firms, privately owned firms, and firms belonging to competitive industries.
